title: Understanding Acceleration
text: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity over time. It can be calculated using the formula: $$a=\frac{v_{f}-v_{i}}{t}$$.

title: Identify Known Values
text: From the problem, we know the initial velocity is $$0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$ (since the cheetah starts from rest), the final velocity is $$30.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$, $$and$$ $$the$$ $$time$$ $$taken$$ $$is$$ $$7.00\, \text{s}$$.
